subject: Quarter kickoff — metric consolidation, owner overlaps & final gate
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter kickoff — metric consolidation, owner overlaps & final gate

Team,

Thanks for the rapid reviews so far. I pulled together a second pass of the OKR slate (attached: Q3_okr_slate_v2.pptx) and tried to collapse duplicate metrics where owners overlapped. Two asks to get to the exec gate by EOD Monday: 

1) Finalize the metric definitions on slides 6–8 (especially the latency family). Please call out exact SLOs (p50/p95/p99), measurement buckets, and which reports will be authoritative.
2) Confirm owner handoffs where we have overlaps — I flagged the Platform vs Product ownership items in the notes. If you don't confirm an ownership change explicitly, we'll retain the current owner for the gate.

Quick constraints: exec expects a 10–12 slide narrative and a clear top-5 metric list. If we need to drop less material metrics, call them out now.

I attached the deck and a working mapping in sheet form is coming from Marissa (cc'd). I'll run a 30-minute pre-read sync at 3pm PT; please accept if you can.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Director, GTM Strategy | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — metric consolidation, owner overlaps & final gate

Soojin —

Thanks, reviewed slide 6 (latency family). Two quick notes: 

- The "API latency" metric on the current slide mixes two different things: p99 token latency at steady-state and end-to-end request latency (cold starts + routing). Can we separate those? Product wants the user-facing end-to-end number for exec conversation; infra wants the p99 token metric for SRE prioritization.
- The availability SLO needs a defined error budget window (30-day rolling); please add that to the definition.

I can take the lead on ensuring the SRE-measurement wording — will push a small edit by 12pm. If Marissa moves ownership of the "model-swap lead time" metric to Platform, please highlight that change in the notes so exec sees the consolidation.

Grace

All — attaching the mapping CSV I mentioned (metrics_mapping.csv). A few decisions from my side: 

- I recommend moving "model-swap lead time" to Platform. Product (my previous owner) will retain "feature rollout success" and "user-facing latency."
- For exec clarity, let's present the top five metrics as: 1) user-facing latency (p95), 2) availability (30-day), 3) cost per 1M tokens, 4) model-swap lead time (Platform), 5) user CSAT for downstream features.

Marissa
